leaf_cases.note: 本轮实际补采与核对 Quartermaster、Voyant 和 Yatra，并复核历史缺口。新找到 Quartermaster（star-fleet-tours/quartermaster-api）：仓库根 LICENSE 的 operative terms（第 0–17 条及 END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS）齐全，SPDX 识别为 AGPL-3.0，但上游文件本身在附录 “How to Apply These Terms to Your New Programs” 第 630 行处截断（32,433 字节，缺示例声明后半段与远程网络提供源码的说明），不能称其为完整许可证文本；GitHub 元数据确认 repo id 971048805；README 与模型代码确认其服务 Star Fleet Tours 的自有 launch-viewing 产品（mission/trip type），Trip 是有销售窗口、check-in/boarding/departure 时间和按船只/票种容量的有日期班次，Booking 记录 lead passenger 的姓名/邮箱/电话、金额、支付/退款状态并沿 draft→confirmed→checked_in→completed/cancelled 流转，BookingItem 记录票种/商品数量、价格与退款（快照未见逐旅客 traveler 表），另有 QR 签到、名单和后台报表；官方 README 自述生产站点为 book.star-fleet.tours（本轮未独立抓取该站点），结合 Docker Compose 自托管部署与完整业务模型，按完整开源应用收录，生产状态以 README 自述为限。Voyant 的官网与文档确认其面向 tour operator 的目录、departures、bookings、suppliers 和 finance 后台；但其曾被索引的 github.com/voyant-travel/voyant 现已 404，官方文档也改为托管服务口径，因此只按商业方案基本记录，不冒充开源。历史候选 Yatra 的许可证并非旧记录的 null/NOASSERTION：WordPress.org 页面、README 和插件主文件均标为 GPLv2+，免费版含 trips、departures/capacity、booking lifecycle、customer accounts，确属完整旅游预订业务模块；但其 GitHub 仓库没有独立 LICENSE 文件，无法在不补造许可证文本的前提下满足本批开源许可快照校验，故只留档为候选，不计入 batch。tourapp/tourapp、PHPTRAVELS、Nairoo/Travter/Trawelio 保留历史结论，本轮未重新取得正文，不当作新通过。
leaf_cases.service_boundary: 本叶要求运营方自有旅游产品目录、有日期/容量的出发实例和乘客预订生命周期。Quartermaster 以 mission/trip 自有产品、dated Trip 班次与 Booking 生命周期满足；Voyant 以目录、出发/可用性、预订与财务后台满足。Yatra 虽核心匹配且为自托管 WordPress 业务模块，但缺少仓库级许可证文件，未作为本批开源条目；不把商业托管或候选插件等同于已通过的开源案例。

fetch_outcomes: Fetched GitHub repository metadata for star-fleet-tours/quartermaster-api (repo id 971048805), README, the repository LICENSE (AGPL-3.0 operative terms present; appendix truncated upstream), deployment guide, and trip/booking/enums models; verified dated trips, per-boat/ticket capacity, booking lifecycle, payments, refunds, check-in and manifests.

Re-fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/star-fleet-tours/quartermaster-api/master/LICENSE on 2026-10-29: identical sha256 f095247d... and 32,433 bytes. GitHub's tree API reports the same LICENSE blob size and the only LICENSE commit (2f8baf2) contains the same truncated file, so no complete upstream LICENSE was available to replace the snapshot with; the appendix gap is documented rather than asserted complete.

Fetched voyant.travel homepage and documentation; they describe a managed tour-operator back office with catalog, departures, bookings, suppliers and finance, but github.com/voyant-travel/voyant returns 404, so it is recorded only as a commercial case.

Fetched wordpress.org/plugins/yatra/, github.com/mantrabrain/yatra, the plugin main file and the official departures/booking docs; GPLv2+ and a complete booking office are documented, but the GitHub repository has no standalone LICENSE file, so it is retained as a candidate rather than entered as an open-source batch case.
GitHub REST API license/metadata requests returned 403 rate-limit responses; repository identity was instead verified from the saved GitHub HTML metadata and raw repository files.
